description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation; the outer L1's score for a candidate is composited (per campaign.json::scoring) over the three proxy metrics produced per task: first_round_delta, after_N_rounds_delta, rounds_to_N. Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7 (~0.44 origin, clear headroom; gsm8k retired — its origin aces target). Target 0.60 (not 0.80) so rounds_to_N varies rather than saturating at the unreached sentinel — the paper ceiling on this stratum is ~0.81. PANEL SIZE = 8 seeds: the θ-LCB winner election needs >= elimination_n_min (6) covered samples to crown, and offline replay of a real round showed 2 tasks -> no winner, 6 -> winner, 8 -> stable; 8 gives a 2-failure margin so one flaky inner tail doesn't drop effective n below the floor and waste the run (l4-outer-loop.md Live-run learnings, bug-5 C).
